'''Seekers''' are a type of [[Mobs|Mob]], placed into the [[Pure Parasites|Pure]] Tier.

They are not currently implemented in the game, but in [https://trello.com/c/uGoACOYB/91-seeker Trello] it is described it as being like smaller versions of [[Ancient Dreadnaut]], [[Bogle]], or [[Wraith]] mobs.

== ''Spawning'' ==
It's implied that they would primarily spawn in the [[Parasite Biome]], although it is reasonable it would work all-the-same were it to be linked to [[Nests]] or [[Colony|Colonies]].


== ''Behavior'' ==

WIP

Seekers are flying, medium-sized ranged Combatants.
It's implied that Seekers will hunt enemies in packs of up to 5 members. When a pack encounters a player, a randomly chosen Seeker would return to their respective [[Parasite Biome]] and call for a raid.


=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

*Seekers, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

=== ''Post Death'' ===

* On death, Seekers have a 50% chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Pure Remains]], an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]] while also leaving an [[Incomplete Crux]].
